edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth; the ruling also says whether it takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, or on its campaign's close where it takes one, it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign, and landing waits for that campaign's close when one is set.
